intro-1.text: What if your customers could close their own support tickets with a single click? No reply, no login, no back and forth.

intro-2.text: That's CLICK-zenn. In the next couple of minutes, we'll build a Close Ticket button and put it into a real Zendesk email.

open-1.text: CLICK-zenn lives right inside Zendesk. Open it from the sidebar

open-2.text: Under Available CLICK-buttons, click "Create new button".

open-3.text: First, give it an internal name, so your team can find it later. We'll call this one Ticket Close.

label-1.text: Now for the words your customer will see. Just type right on the button.

label-2.text: Close Ticket. Short, clear, and it says exactly what will happen.

style-1.text: It already works, but let's make it look the part. A friendly green background,

style-2.text: white text, bold lettering, and softer corners.

style-3.text: CLICK-zenn hosts the button image for you, so it looks exactly like this in every email client.

action-1.text: Next, tell the button what to do. Click Add button action, and choose Set Ticket Status.

action-2.text: Set the new status to Solved. That's the whole workflow.

action-3.text: Does your Zendesk require an assignee before a ticket can be solved? Add one here, and turn on If Blank, so existing assignments stay untouched.

save-1.text: Click Create. CLICK-zenn saves your button and generates a ready-to-paste snippet.

email-1.text: Now put it where your customers will see it. In Zendesk, open a trigger that emails the requester.

email-2.text: Write your message, then paste the snippet right below it.

email-3.text: Save the trigger, and you're live.

result-1.text: Here's what your customer receives. A friendly message, and one obvious button.

result-2.text: One click, and they land on a confirmation page. Nothing else to do.

result-3.text: And back in Zendesk, the ticket is already solved. No reply to read, and no agent time spent.

outro-1.text: That's your first CLICK-zenn button, built in minutes.

outro-2.text: From here, you can offer a Still need help choice, make buttons single use, or follow up with a one-click satisfaction survey.

outro-3.text: Find CLICK-zenn on the Zendesk Marketplace, and let your customers close the loop with a single click.
